definitions.gloss: to push forward, to advance, to promote
definitions.explanation: To actively advance or promote something, such as a plan, policy, or reform. Implies determined effort to make progress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{進|すす}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The government is pushing forward with reforms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{押|お}し{進|すす}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The company is actively promoting digitalization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{進|すす}める⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: We need a budget to push the plan forward.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). What is being advanced takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push) + ⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ (to advance). The compound emphasizes forceful or determined advancement.

ASPECT: Very often appears as {押|お}し{進|すす}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧, describing an ongoing policy or initiative rather than a moment of pushing — the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form is the normal way to report a campaign in progress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{進|すす}める (push forward reforms)
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{進|すす}める (advance a plan)
- ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{進|すす}める (promote a policy)
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{進|すす}める (push forward a business)

USAGE: Formal — at home in news reports, business writing, and public statements. Compared with plain ⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧, it adds the sense that the advance is being driven against inertia or resistance.
